blind_physics_independence.counting_rule: counted over raw physics families; residual variants, emulators, and combiners never add to this number
blind_physics_independence.rule: ez-wo15-independence-v1: two backends are independent physics families only when the functional/interaction class differs, the parameter vectors differ and neither is derived from the other, neither is a residual or emulator of the other, and no shared post-freeze target truth selected either of them. A shared solver implementation does not by itself deny independence, but it is a correlated-numerics caveat that is recorded on both adjudications

next_gate: WO-16 Known-Superheavy Historical Challenge becomes available: two independent blind-eligible physics families now exist with reproducible fits. WO-16 remains a computational historical validation challenge and authorizes no experimental synthesis
